description: Refresh expired upload links for selected files or multipart part numbers in the same batch. Keep successful uploads. Single-PUT file keys may change; use the returned keys when finalizing.

batchId.description: Keep the original upload batch ID.

files.description: Only files or parts whose upload links expired. Other uploads remain available.

partNumbers.description: Parts to refresh. Omit to refresh all parts.

partSize.description: Use the original returned partSize; defaults to 94371840 bytes when omitted.

name: ads_upload_refresh_urls
title: Refresh Upload Links
